parsed.explanation: The worst documented feature is state-tolerated, state-directed targeting: recurring extortion-driven police violence against visibly trans people (2025 retaliatory beatings of 12 hijras; arrests of 12 more; April 2024 arrests of five trans women at the international airport), a 2017 raid where police beat and arrested 28 with media allowed to photograph, and Section 377 plus a 'suspicious behaviour' provision used as harassment levers. A national monitor records 260 violations against 426 LGBTQI+ people in 2025, rising since 2022, including murder, abduction and fabricated charges, with a prominent trans advocate murdered in 2025 and impunity implied. Post-2024 Islamist mobilisation and official dismissal of LGBT rights leave thin recourse; no anti-discrimination protection exists. Hijra recognition, gender-marker change and pride events are climate positives only. This sits in the organised-targeting tier, but below 0.15: prosecutions are rare, no custody sexual violence or execution is documented.
